name: RadioGroup
summary: A set of mutually exclusive options, of which exactly one is chosen, each a Radio inside a RadioGroup. Choose it over a dropdown when there are few options (roughly five or fewer) worth showing at once, and over checkboxes when only one may be picked.

inputs.name: layout
inputs.description: RadioGroup: stack the radios in a column, a row, or a row with each label below its indicator.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: RadioGroup: the value of the selected Radio, when controlled.

inputs.name: defaultValue
inputs.description: RadioGroup: the initially selected Radio's value, when uncontrolled.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: RadioGroup: the form name shared by every Radio; generated when omitted.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: RadioGroup: disables every Radio in it. Radio: disables that one item.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: RadioGroup: a selection is required; passes required to each Radio.

inputs.name: onChange
inputs.description: RadioGroup: called with the newly selected value. (Radio's own onChange fires only when that Radio becomes selected, never on deselection.)

inputs.name: items
inputs.description: The Radio children, each with a value (string), an optional label slot, an optional labelPosition (after or below; defaults to below inside a horizontal-stacked group, else after) and an optional disabled.

anatomy.name: Group
anatomy.description: The RadioGroup root: a flex container of Radios, aligned to the start of the cross axis, with no gap between items.

anatomy.name: Radio container
anatomy.description: One Radio: an inline-flex row (a centred column when the label is below) holding indicator and label and carrying the focus outline.

anatomy.name: Hidden input
anatomy.description: A transparent native radio over the indicator column (indicator plus spacingHorizontalS each side, full height; full width when the label is below). It takes focus and all native attributes.

anatomy.name: Indicator
anatomy.description: A 16px circle with a border; when checked a dot fills its centre, drawn by a pseudo-element or by a custom child the caller supplies.

anatomy.name: Checked dot
anatomy.description: The ::after circle in currentColor, scaled to 62.5% of the indicator, shown only when checked.

variants.description: The group is a column; each Radio's label is after its indicator.
The group is a row (the flex default); each Radio's label is after its indicator. Radios sit edge to edge, the label's end padding giving the only separation.
The group is a row and each Radio defaults its label below the indicator: the Radio becomes a centred column, the label pads spacingVerticalXS above and centres its text.

layout.text: The group is display flex with align-items flex-start; vertical sets flex-direction column, horizontal and horizontal-stacked leave it a row. No gap is declared.
Each Radio root is a relative inline-flex row; with the label below it becomes a column with its items centred.

The indicator is a 16px circle (borderRadiusCircular) with a strokeWidthThin solid border, 12px font size for a custom glyph, margin spacingVerticalS above and below and spacingHorizontalS either side, so the row is 32px tall; it never shrinks and ignores the pointer.
The checked dot is a 16px circle in currentColor scaled by 0.625 (a 10px dot) with a transform rather than a size, to avoid rounding errors at 125% display scaling.
The hidden input sits at the start of the row, full height and 16px plus 2 × spacingHorizontalS wide (32px); with the label below it spans the full width and 16px plus 2 × spacingVerticalS tall.

Label after: padding spacingVerticalS by spacingHorizontalS with the start side trimmed to spacingHorizontalXS, and a negative vertical margin of (16px − lineHeightBase300) / 2 so the first line centres on the indicator without growing the row.
Label below: the same padding with the top reduced to spacingVerticalXS, text centred.

states.text: Unchecked at rest: label colorNeutralForeground3, indicator border colorNeutralStrokeAccessible, no dot.

Unchecked: label colorNeutralForeground2, border colorNeutralStrokeAccessibleHover. Checked: border colorCompoundBrandStrokeHover, dot colorCompoundBrandForeground1Hover; the label stays Foreground1. Instant.

While hovered and pressed. Unchecked: label colorNeutralForeground1, border colorNeutralStrokeAccessiblePressed. Checked: border colorCompoundBrandStrokePressed, dot colorCompoundBrandForeground1Pressed.

Label colorNeutralForeground1; indicator border colorCompoundBrandStroke and dot colorCompoundBrandForeground1. There is no fill: the ring stays hollow around the dot. A custom indicator child is hidden (opacity 0) until checked.

Keyboard focus draws the default createFocusOutlineStyle outline around the focused Radio (indicator and label): 2px colorStrokeFocus2 just outside it, rounded borderRadiusMedium; selector focus-within, following the input.
Label colorNeutralForegroundDisabled with a default cursor; indicator border colorNeutralStrokeDisabled and dot colorNeutralForegroundDisabled, checked or not. No hover or press change.

behaviour.text: Clicking a Radio's indicator column or label, or moving to it with the arrow keys, selects it and deselects the others; RadioGroup's onChange reports the new value. Only the selected Radio fires its own onChange.
Every Radio in the group shares the group's name (generated if absent), so the platform enforces single selection and form submission.
The group's disabled and required reach every Radio in it.
No transition is declared: every colour change is instant.
The focus outline appears only for keyboard focus, never after a pointer press.

keyboard: Tab moves focus into the group, to the selected Radio (or the first when none is selected), and Tab again leaves it
Arrow keys move focus and selection to the next or previous Radio, wrapping
Space selects the focused Radio when none is selected
semantics: the group root is role radiogroup; label it with aria-labelledby or a Field label
each Radio is a native input type=radio, so checked, disabled and required come from the platform
each Radio's label slot is a <label> bound to its input

notes.text: The 16px indicator, the 12px custom glyph size and the 0.625 dot scale are constants in the styles file; no token gives them.
The group declares no gap: vertical radios stack as touching 32px rows and horizontal radios abut, separated only by each label's spacingHorizontalS end padding.
A checked radio is not filled: unlike a checked checkbox, the ring stays hollow and only the brand-foreground dot and brand-stroke border mark it.

Under forced colours: an unchecked indicator border is ButtonBorder (a system colour outside the eight in foundations); checked turns border and dot Highlight; disabled turns label, border and dot GrayText; the focus outline turns Highlight.
Arrow-key roving between radios is the native radio behaviour the hidden inputs inherit; the styles file does not state it. Label typography comes from the Label component, body1 by default.
